ordering: initial snapshot index 0; one snapshot after each accepted command in array order; no timestamps or frame rate

initial.setup: named versioned recipe; all preconditions explicit; never counted as replay gameplay

save_roundtrip.owner: R17 encode/decode in private temporary memory; no platform writes

snapshot.persistent: exact active source-layout block bytes encoded as lowercase hex; format and declared lengths bound in snapshot
snapshot.script: versioned existing checkpoint bytes on a normalized copy: zero stack entries >= stack_depth; zero pending_request when absent; stable resource IDs resolved by pinned registry
snapshot.objects: active runtime count and every active object scalar in slot order; null only when no runtime is attached
snapshot.encounter: every declared runtime scalar/array in fixed order including RNG state/calls, bag, roamer history, immunity and previous behavior; null only when inactive
snapshot.battle: every declared state/mon scalar and fixed array; parties/caught Pokemon through source codec; active ordered events; RNG state/calls; null only when inactive
snapshot.derived: world/progression/objective/pending-request summaries are explicit observations; they never replace raw persistent or active runtime domains

hash.serialization: UTF-8 JSON, sorted keys, separators comma/colon, ensure_ascii false, no floats, trailing LF
hash.state: hash canonical complete snapshot including version, format, domains, observations; provenance separately pinned in fixture

expected.immutable: checked-in expected state/domain digests and observations per snapshot; no bless/update option in verification or CI
expected.provenance: source pin plus fixture recipes or explicit source blob hashes; mutation requires reviewed checkpoint

failure.behavior: nonzero at first invalid command/probe failure/snapshot-count mismatch/observation or digest divergence
failure.incomplete: VM error or unhandled request never treated as success; bounded slices may end at explicitly expected pending requests
